Seven isolated company/app logo crops retain reference attribution. Full frames/video/mobile-screen textures are not loaded. Original reference audio included for comparison only.

Source chart values/captions are reproduced as observed film content only; they are not verified actual investment results, forecasts, tax support or product claims.

Observed chart curves are reconstructed from selected geometric landmarks; exact source data curves, easing and shared-object transition correspondence differ.

Calendar/small source currencies/counter interpolation and tax flag microdetails may differ.

Phone is an independently drawn layered Canvas device and complete UI with affine perspective; original phone material, exact3Dlighting/projection and source dashboard detail are not reproduced exactly.
